HERO_DESCRIPTION: An AI agent set up a FastComments account. Claim it to take ownership.
NOT_FOUND_HEADING: This claim link is not valid.
NOT_FOUND_BODY: The link may have already been used, or the account was not claimed within 72 hours and has been deleted. Ask your agent to create a new one.
CONFIRM_BODY: Only claim accounts you asked an agent to create. Once claimed, you own the account, its settings, and its API keys, and it appears in your dashboard.
CLAIMED_BODY: The account, its settings, and its API keys have been attached to your login. You can manage everything from the dashboard.
CLAIMED_MANAGED_BODY: It is now a managed tenant of your account. Switch to it to manage its settings, or find it later under your tenants.
CHOOSE_HEADING: You are already signed in to an account.
CHOOSE_BODY: Each login owns one account. You can attach this new account to the one you are signed in to as a managed tenant, or sign out and claim it with a different login.
KEYS_BODY_BEFORE_CLAIM: The agent that created this account holds these keys. They give full access to the account. They are revoked the moment you claim unless you choose to keep them below.
KEYS_BODY_AFTER_CLAIM: You chose to keep the agent's keys, so the agent, or whoever runs it, still has full access to the account. Revoke any key you no longer want it to have.
KEYS_BODY_MANAGED: You chose to keep the agent's keys, so the agent, or whoever runs it, still has full access to the new tenant. Switch to it and open API Secrets to revoke any you do not want to keep.
KEYS_REVOKED_BODY: The keys the agent held were revoked when you claimed the account. Create a new key from API Secrets if you want to give an agent access again.
KEYS_REVOKED_MANAGED_BODY: The keys the agent held were revoked when you attached the account. Switch to the new tenant and open API Secrets to create a new one.
KEEP_KEYS_LABEL: Keep the agent's API keys working
KEEP_KEYS_HELP: Check this only if you asked an agent to set up this account and want it to keep using it. Otherwise whoever created this account loses access as soon as you claim it.
ATTACH_HELP: The new account becomes a managed tenant. Its usage is billed to your account.
NO_WHITE_LABEL: Attaching managed tenants requires a paid plan with white labeling. You can still sign out and claim this account with a different login.
NO_PERMISSION: You need the Manage Data permission on your account to attach managed tenants. You can still sign out and claim this account with a different login.
BUTTON_LOGOUT: Sign Out and Claim With Another Login
LOGOUT_HELP: You will be signed out and brought back to this page to sign in or create a new login.
